name: EmbroideredWord
job: A word or short phrase that is sewn onto fabric stitch by stitch, with thread texture and a needle leading the line
visitor_action: none (stitches itself when scrolled into view); hovering or tapping a letter sews it again
owner_settings: Re-sew a letter on hover (on/off, default off)
mobile: same, wraps to more lines with larger stitches; tap a letter to re-sew it
motion: A steel needle swings in from the spool and pierces the denim; each pierce dimples the fabric, pulls a loop that springs tight, and a Verlet-rope thread trails from the eye to the spool; the stitch rate accelerates across the word, then the thread is snipped (recoil, flying fibres, frayed tail) and the needle lifts away, about 4.8s in all. Hovering or tapping a letter re-sews it; Enter re-sews the word; the sheen follows the pointer. Reduced motion shows the finished embroidery.

checks.render: pass (1 fix: stray space-column slivers + frame-starved progress; headless 1280/worst shots catch the run mid-stitch because virtual time barely fires rAF, finished state verified in a real browser and in the 375/reduced shots)

provenance: original, built from a concept description
art_direction: Denim chainstitch: indigo 3/1 twill drawn thread by thread, a yoke seam with marigold twin topstitching, and lettering built as real geometry (distance-field contour rows of individual chain links: marigold outline row, cream fill rows) with twisted-strand shading, cast shadows, fabric pucker, stray fibres and a pointer-following thread sheen.
notes: Satin stitches run at one fixed angle (not per stroke), so up close it reads slightly as a striped fill and a touch rosy; hover re-thread not verified in a browser (shared preview tab was busy). 2026-11-23: redesigned (batch A) to denim chainstitch (real stitch geometry, canvas 2D; props: stitchStyle now filled|outline, new outlineColor).
